correctness.domain_rule: D_search and D_cert have disjoint exact input digests
correctness.comparison_rule: every edge is direct; tolerance transitivity is forbidden

candidate_identity.search_object: concrete post-pass MLIR state plus schedule assignment and transformation trace
candidate_identity.duplicate_rule: duplicate MLIR attempts remain in the audit log and do not consume candidate budget
candidate_identity.failed_attempt_rule: one distinct exact candidate that fails before state formation consumes one budget unit
candidate_identity.expanded_arm_nesting_rule: an expanded arm visits the fixed-structure schedule spine in the same C-conditioned order before spending its remaining equal total budget on other concrete lowering states
candidate_identity.c_fixed_rule: the canonical structural path plus one deterministic target projection of C forms exactly one candidate and performs no search
candidate_identity.abstraction_rule: no implementation-family object, family id, or named emitter participates in generation, legality, or selection

measurement.external_match_rule: operator, shape, dtype, layout, output relation, timed boundary, cache policy, device and profiler must match exactly
measurement.timed_scope: prepared launch or prepared graph only; allocation and correctness synchronization are outside the timed closure
measurement.finalist_rule: fresh round-robin remeasurement with alternating traversal; initial ranking samples are excluded
measurement.confirmation_rule: equal-count fresh matched-baseline and target batches in alternating pair order
measurement.warmup_rule: before confirmation, Source and target prepared thunks receive the same declared untimed time budget in round-robin order; cold-data timing then evicts L2 before every measured launch
measurement.e3_e2_comparison_rule: the primary marginal E3/E2 gain selects fixed-structure schedule-spine best and expanded best from the same E3 candidate timing receipt; separately launched E2/E3 absolute latencies remain a diagnostic cross-report ratio
measurement.aggregation: median per side with every paired batch retained

budget_rule: C-Fixed receives exactly one deterministic target projection of C; all search arms receive the same caller-supplied total budget over distinct post-pass MLIR states and distinct failed exact candidates
